items.title: What Gemini 4 Argon Is Actually Good For
items.summary: Gemini 4 Argon is finally in testers' hands, and the verdict is messier than the benchmarks: shaky at the agentic coding Google desperately needs, strangely gated behind harness tiers, but genuinely different — and possibly the best writing model anyone's shipped. Plus: an alleged Saudi spy inside OpenAI, JPMorgan slams the door on third-party agents, and Character AI goes bankrupt.
